name: KRAFTON Raon-1 mini
context_scaling: none (NoPE): rope_parameters is null and the card claims 262,144 native
attention_variant: Hybrid linear/full attention, 18 Raon Delta Attention layers + 7 Gated MLA layers (config rda_config.mla_layers [4,8,12,16,20,24,25] - layer 0, the dense first_k_dense_replace layer, is also MLA, so the 7 KV-bearing layers are 0,4,8,12,16,20,24; entry 25 is out of range on a 25-layer model and is a 1-indexing stray). RDA is Kimi Delta Attention with decoupled erase/write gates; it carries a fixed-size state, so only the 7 MLA layers hold a per-token KV cache. NoPE MLA: q_lora_rank 576, kv_lora_rank 512, qk_nope_head_dim 128, qk_rope_head_dim 64, v_head_dim 128, output gate on.

notes:
ADDED 2026-11-25 from the trending sweep (likes 68, downloads 0 - a day-old release, not a popularity pick). Raon-1 mini is the finished release of the Raon-1 mini preview line, TRAINED FROM SCRATCH by KRAFTON AI (card says so), so it is a base model, not a derivative of raon-1-mini-preview. It is not a fine-tune of any catalog base and shares no parameter lineage that the card states.

PARAMS: params_b 28.783 = HF safetensors.total 28,783,231,202 (BF16 3.11B + F8_E4M3 25.67B + F32 0.0001B) which matches the card's 28.8B. active_params_b 4.3 is the card's own activated figure. flops_per_token_active = 2 x 4.3e9 = 8.6e9 (schema 2N convention).

KV BASIS: 8,064 bytes/token = 7 MLA layers x (kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64) x 2 bytes (bf16) = 8,064 B, i.e. 7.875 KiB; the card rounds this to 'about 8 KiB per token in BF16', which agrees. The 18 RDA layers contribute a fixed state that does not grow with context. At the full 262,144-token context that is 7.9 KiB x 262,144 = 2.11 GB of MLA cache - versus ~89 GB for the same context on a 25-layer, 40-KV-head GQA model at head_dim 128, which is the point of the hybrid. The RDA state itself is sized by rda_config (40 heads x 128 dim, conv_kernel_size 4, 4 mHC streams) and is constant per sequence, not per token.

EVIDENCE - what it wins and loses in class (active<=4.6B): WINS MMLU Pro 82.7 vs nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16 81.94 (and vs raon-1-mini-preview 76.5 in the same table), MultiChallenge 64.9 vs nemotron-3-5-bolt-e4b-4gb 53.1, and SWE-Verified 71.0 vs raon-1-mini-preview 70.8. LOSES AA-LCR 70.7 (sage-a1-5 81.0, clover-35b-a3b-preview 72.0), GPQA Diamond 86.0 (ornith-1-5-35b-a3b 89.2), IFBench 84.9 (flint 89.2), LiveCodeBench v6 81.7 (kolibri-1-1 93.0) and BFCL v4 61.6 (qwen3-5-35b-a3b 67.3). Terminal-Bench Lite 52.0 is NOT compared to the catalog's Terminal-Bench 2.1 rows (ornith 67.8) because the variant differs.

WITHIN ITS OWN CARD it finishes last-or-near-last on LiveCodeBench v6 (81.7 vs Flint 88.5), Terminal-Bench Lite (52.0 vs Inkling 2 Mini 77.0), AutomationBench (39.9 vs Qwen3.8-27B 58.7), BFCL v4 (61.6 vs Qwen3.8-27B 72.4) and AA-LCR (70.7 vs Muse Glimmer 81.3). It also regresses against its own preview on the AA-Omniscience Index (1.0 vs 3.5). HARDWARE GATE PASSED and this is the reason it is worth recording: 4.3B active on a 28.8B MoE with only 7 KV-bearing layers. The card ships MXFP8 (30 GiB repo) and NVFP4, and states NVFP4 runs on a single RTX 5090 (32 GB) - i.e. this is a frontier-adjacent agentic/Korean model that fits one consumer card at 4-bit, no CPU offload needed. Card also links a KRAFTON llama.cpp fork branch 'raon-1-mini' for the reasoning-effort steering.

CAVEATS: custom code (trust_remote_code). Every score is vendor_claim - no third party has re-run it. The red highlight in the card is 'best within the MoE group' only, so the Qwen3.8-27B / Muse Glimmer columns beating it is not a contradiction.
